description: List detection rules as compact summaries: name, mode (test or prod), status, severity, schedule, throttle, app scope and trigger stats. The detection SQL is left out; securenow_alert_rule_get returns one rule in full.

active.description: true lists only rules with status Active.

isSystem.description: true lists only template rules, false only your own.

mode.description: Optional mode filter: test or prod.

status.description: Optional status filter: Active, Disabled or Paused.

name: securenow_alert_rules_list
title: List Alert Rules
